claims.quote: Consensus was reached on the presence of 14 comorbidities in patients with Severe Developmental and Epileptic Encephalopathy (Severe DEE) spanning non-seizure neurological disorders and other organ systems;

claims.object_text: impacts mostly severe and unlikely to improve or resolve in Severe DEE
claims.quote: impacts were mostly severe and unlikely to improve or resolve.

claims.object_text: cognitive and sleep-related comorbidities as well as fine and gross motor delays
claims.quote: Across Mild/Moderate Developmental and Epileptic Encephalopathy (Mild/Moderate DEE), Neurodevelopmental Delay with Generalized Epilepsy (NDDwGE), and NDD without Epilepsy (NDDwoE) phenotypes, cognitive and sleep-related comorbidities as well as fine and gross motor delays may be present but are less severe and more likely to improve compared to Severe DEE.

claims.object_text: seizures would largely resolve in SeL(F)IE phenotype
claims.quote: There was no consensus on comorbidities in the SeL(F)IE phenotype but strong conesensus that seizures would largely resolve.

claims.object_text: seizure freedom is rare in Severe DEE but may occur in some with Mild/Moderate DEE and NDDwGE
claims.quote: Seizure freedom is rare in patients with Severe DEE but may occur in some with Mild/Moderate DEE and NDDwGE.

claims.object_text: significant comorbidities present in most phenotypes; most severe and pervasive in Severe DEE
claims.quote: Significant comorbidities are present in most phenotypes of SCN8A-related disorders but are most severe and pervasive in the Severe DEE phenotype.
